definitions: An account of imaginary or real people and events told for entertainment.
A report of an item of news in a newspaper, magazine, or news broadcast.
A plot or storyline of a book, film, or play.
A lie or an untrue statement.
examples: She told us a fascinating story.
The newspaper ran a front-page story about the scandal.
The story of the film was quite complex.
Don't tell me stories; I know what happened.
